option.name: content
option.value:
"Agis comme un développeur C++ senior. Analyse mes changements actuels et rédige un message de commit en suivant rigoureusement ce format :
Commence par un préfixe (ex: feat: pour une nouveauté, fix: pour une correction, refactor: pour une amélioration de code, docs: pour les commentaires).
Ajoute un titre court et clair au présent (impératif).
Laisse une ligne vide.
Liste chaque changement sous forme de bullet points ( - ) en expliquant ce qui a été modifié et pourquoi (ex: 'Correction de l'overflow dans operator*' au lieu de 'Modif code').
N'inclus pas de fioritures, utilise un ton technique et précis."

list.name: Changes
list.comment:
refactor: Cleanup build scripts and optimize event-handling loop
- Removed legacy `.d` build dependency files to declutter the project structure. - Updated IntelliJ workspace settings to reflect reduced file dependencies and streamlined project management. - Adjusted epoll event-handling loop in `main.cpp` for better client connection handling and buffer management. - Refactored `sockaddrInit` in `Server.cpp` to remove unnecessary parameters and simplify initialization. - Configured non-blocking I/O for client file descriptors in the event loop to improve responsiveness.

task.summary:
feat: Add IntelliJ project configuration files and update server class variables
This commit adds IntelliJ IDEA configuration files (.idea directory) to the repository for IDE-specific project settings. It also updates the `Server.hpp` class, renaming a private member variable to follow a consistent naming convention.

feat: Add IDE configuration, update server variables, and refine formatting
- Added `.idea` directory to include IntelliJ IDEA project configuration files for easier project setup. - Updated `Server.hpp` to make `isServerWorking` a static variable for shared access across instances. - Implemented basic definitions in `Server.cpp` for `isServerWorking` initialization and constructors.

feat: Refactor server initialization and add build dependencies
- Moved server socket initialization to a dedicated `initializeServer` function for modularity and clarity. - Introduced `setServerId` in `Server` class to encapsulate server ID assignment logic. - Added build dependencies files (`.build/src/main.d` and `.build/class/irc.d`) for improved compilation management. - Updated `.clang-format` for standardized code style, including tab indentation and customized brace wrapping. - Enhanced `Server` exception handling by implementing `errorServerSocket` with a descriptive error message. - Updated `.idea` project configuration to reflect new formatting and build rules.

feat: Add logging for server details and improve initialization
- Added `operator<<` to `Server` class for logging server socket details to `std::ostream`. - Introduced `sockaddrInit` in `Server` for initializing `SOCKADDR_IN` structure with default values. - Added `getServerId` method to retrieve the server ID for improved encapsulation. - Updated `Define.hpp` to include a default `PORT` value and adjusted macro formatting for readability.

feat: Enhance server initialization and logging
- Updated `initializeServer` to accept command-line arguments for port and password. - Modified `main` to validate the required number of arguments and handle exceptions. - Enhanced `Server` class: - Added `setServerPass` to set server password. - Updated `sockaddrInit` to parse and bind the server port dynamically. - Added methods to retrieve server port and password for better encapsulation. - Extended `operator<<` to log server port and password. - Adjusted structure in `Server` to improve readability and encapsulation. - Updated IDE configuration files to include formatting rules for consistency.

feat: Enhance server initialization and logging
- Updated `initializeServer` to accept command-line arguments for port and password. - Modified `main` to validate the required number of arguments and handle exceptions. - Enhanced `Server` class: - Added `setServerPass` to set server password. - Updated `sockaddrInit` to parse and bind the server port dynamically. - Added methods to retrieve server port and password for better encapsulation. - Extended `operator<<` to log server port and password. - Adjusted structure in `Server` to improve readability and encapsulation. - Updated IDE configuration files to include formatting rules for consistency.

refactor: Relocate and refactor `Server` class and project structure
- Moved `Server` class implementation files to `src/Server` for better modularity. - Renamed private member variables in `Server` to follow consistent naming (`_` prefix added). - Added `setServerPort` method in `Server` for explicit port assignment. - Refactored `sockaddrInit` to directly bind socket with private members. - Modified `Makefile` to include updated file paths. - Updated includes in `main.cpp` and `Server.hpp` to reflect new structure. - Removed redundant and unused code in `main.cpp` related to client socket interaction. - Adjusted IDE-specific configuration files for file structure changes and dependency indexing.

refactor: Simplify socket binding and modularize `Server` methods
- Refactored `sockaddrInit` to use private member `_port` directly for streamlined initialization. - Added explicit socket binding and listening in `main.cpp` to separate concerns. - Introduced `std::memset` in `sockaddrInit` for robust zero-initialization of `SOCKADDR_IN`. - Removed redundant `bind` call from `sockaddrInit` to maintain modularity. - Updated `Server.cpp` to include missing `cstring` header for compatibility.

refactor: Cleanup build scripts and optimize event-handling loop
- Removed legacy `.d` build dependency files to declutter the project structure. - Updated IntelliJ workspace settings to reflect reduced file dependencies and streamlined project management. - Adjusted epoll event-handling loop in `main.cpp` for better client connection handling and buffer management. - Refactored `sockaddrInit` in `Server.cpp` to remove unnecessary parameters and simplify initialization. - Configured non-blocking I/O for client file descriptors in the event loop to improve responsiveness.
